The typographic book visuals on this site are editorial treatments, not reproductions of the printed covers.

Why I write about sport.

Sport takes up a large part of my life, but some of the questions around it are easier to examine away from the court. What do we expect from it? How can a parent be supportive? What changes when the commitment becomes more demanding?

The books are a way to spend more time with those questions. They sit alongside my studies and digital projects as a different kind of work: developing an idea, finding the right structure and making the result clear enough for someone else to use.
